name: novel-writer
description: Write, outline, edit, and manage novel-length fiction with structured chapter-by-chapter support.

interface.longDescription: A full novel-writing toolset: brainstorm premises, outline arcs, write chapters with consistent character voices, manage plot threads, and export structured manuscripts. Supports chapter-by-chapter writing with continuity checks, style guide adherence, and revision tracking.
defaultPrompt: Use this plugin to write, outline, or edit a novel-length fiction project.
